about: Slack iOS snapshot regression suite: npm run snapshots (tools/snapshots.mjs). Each entry renders a kit-gallery specimen or an app route at @3x and diffs it against Slack's snapshot PNG (paths relative to SLACK_IOS_LFS_DIR, default in tools/ios/paths.mjs: slack-objc-latest, main @ 14b3cbaf). Component PNGs are a 2 x 2 grid (light / dark rows, normal / high-contrast columns); crop 'light' / 'dark' is the normal-contrast column. maxDiff is the % of pixels allowed to differ, set just above the numbers of 2026-09-30; change one only with a reason (npm run snapshots -- --update rewrites them all).
